paite: Tuite tung ah na tanghou pai in; ni tampi nung a mukhe ding na hi ngal a.
heading: Mipil Thilhih

paite: Sagih kiang ah tantuan pia in, ahi, giat ngei kiang ah; leitung a bang gilou hong om ding ahia chih lah na thei ngal kei a.
Meipite vuah a adimleh, leitung ah akihih awngthawl uh; huan simlam a sing apukleh, hiam mallam ah, apukna mun ah, huai ah a-om ding hi.
Huih ngeingaihmi in atuh kei ding a; meipi limsakmi in a-at kei ding hi.
Huih lampi hiam, amah nau toh omna gilsung a guhte bang hong chi khan uh ahia chih na theih louh bang in; bang teng bawlpa Pathian thilhih na thei kei hi.
Zingsang in na chi tuh inla, nitak in na khut ton maimah ke'n; koi pen hong lohching ding ahia, hiai hia huai hia, ahihkeileh hong hoih tuaktuak ding uhia chih lah na thei ngal kei a.
Diktak in khovak anuam a, mitte a dia nisa muh thil nuamtak ahi.
Ahi, mi kum tampi adamleh, huaite tengteng ah kipak hen; himahleh khomial hunte theigige hen, tampi pha ding uh lah ahi ngal a. Ahong om tengteng bangmah lou ahi.

Aw tangval, na tuailai in kipak in; na tuailai nite ah na lungtang in hon kipaksak hen, na lungtang lampite ah leh na mitte muh in om in; himahleh hiai thilte tengteng ziak in Pathian in nang vaihawmna a hon pi ding ahi chih thei in.
heading: Tuailaite Thuhilhna

paite: Huaiziak in na lungtang a kipan lungkhamna suankhia inla, na sa a kipan gilou koihmang in; tuailaina leh khan lut lai lah bangmah lou ahi ngal a.
